status: Controlled reconstruction comparison; no absolute accuracy or complete-plant claim

sources.label: Earlier result
sources.description: Earlier: 32 dense views, original camera pairs and sensor-dependent filtering.

sources.label: Filtering fix only
sources.description: Filtering fix: the same 32 depth maps and camera alignments. RGB surfaces can pass where sensor depth is missing. Other surface checks remain unchanged.

sources.label: Filtering fix: before cleanup
sources.description: The filtering fix before statistical cleanup: keeps all fragments that passed the same multi-view support and conflict checks. Preserves the checked bud patch, but other retained fragments may include noise.

sources.label: Closer-view trial
sources.description: Closer-view trial: 64 dense views with nearer camera pairs, corrected filtering and freshly checked ICP alignment. Helps some structures but can lose others.

sources.label: Combined pairs: after cleanup
sources.description: Complementary pairs: retains old accepted depths and adds only unambiguous missing pixels with at least three distinct agreeing pairs. Same 32 camera alignments and surface checks, followed by statistical cleanup.

sources.label: Combined pairs: fine fragments retained
sources.description: Complementary pairs before statistical cleanup. Keeps all fragments passing the unchanged multi-view support and conflict checks. Incomplete plant parts and potentially incorrect fragments remain; no shape completion is applied.

limits: Shared scene review crops include pots/background, may omit outlying foliage.
New point count is not a plant-completeness or accuracy score.
Different stereo maps share input images; supporting anchors are not independent statistical trials.
Scale remains conditional. Hidden surfaces require other observations.
